verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Notte sessions only as cloud-hosted browsers: "isolated browser instances running in the cloud", MCP that starts "cloud browser sessions", and API requests that require a Bearer token. Nothing documents running the agent against a local browser without a cloud account. The GitHub repo describes the agent's capabilities but does not show a local or offline mode.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the agent against a local browser on my own machine for development, without any cloud account
